fields.title: Find a title in the collection

sections.What it does: Search reaches the whole consortium. A borrower standing in one [branch](../glossary/example-libraries.md#branch) sees stock in every other, and may place a hold on any of it.
sections.Who it is for: Anyone. The catalogue answers a search without a card, so a person who has not joined yet still uses this.
sections.Why it exists: A borrower who cannot find a title does not borrow it. Discovery is the only surface most borrowers ever use, and every other offering starts here.
sections.Surfaces: The public catalogue at `catalogue.example.com`, and the same pages in the kiosk profile on the branch terminals.
sections.Known limitations: A title the supplier has sent no jacket image for renders a placeholder.
